repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a periodic `if` check instead of a blocking rising-edge wait. The IR requires the action to fire exactly when the button transitions to 'pushed' (rising edge), whereas the candidate only checks the state at the start of each 1-second iteration, missing transitions that occur between checks.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with the standard two-wait rearming pattern: block until the condition is false (if previously true), then block until it becomes true, execute the body, and mark as fired. This ensures the action fires on the exact rising edge regardless of the wrapper period.
